linhas.en: "The supporting characters did a good job of making themselves feel present."
linhas.jp: 「脇を占める方々だが存在感では引けを取らぬな」
linhas.Pt-br: "Os personagens secundários fizeram um bom trabalho em marcar presença."
linhas.label: $$$message_0307_0001_0000$$$

linhas.jp: 「零観氏の名前は『一成の兄ということで、一より前の数字、それならいっそ柳洞ゼロでどうよ？』[cacheimage storage=凛巫女服01b(中)][wvl canskip=0 time=400][chgfg time=300 storage=凛巫女服01b(中)]……という発想ですって！？[cacheimage storage=凛巫女服01c(中)][wvl canskip=0 time=400][chgfg time=300 storage=凛巫女服01c(中)]　まあ、いいか」

[cacheimage storage=凛巫女服01b(中)][wvl canskip=0 time=400][chgfg time=300 storage=凛巫女服01b(中)]...[font italic=true]Foi daí[font italic=false] que tiraram a ideia!? [cacheimage storage=凛巫女服01c(中)][wvl canskip=0 time=400][chgfg time=300 storage=凛巫女服01c(中)] Bem, deixa pra lá."

linhas.en: "Everyone's in work clothes or uniforms. Maybe the focus is on their feet."
linhas.jp: 「全員仕事着や制服だから、ポイントは足下かな？」
linhas.Pt-br: "Todos estão com roupas de trabalho ou uniformes. Talvez o foco esteja nos pés deles."

linhas.en: "You can't see their feet during the game."
